rows.grounds: indeclinable numeral adverb indicating threefold repetition

items.question: Which repeated acts of devouring, crushing, breaking, and paralyzing are ritually commanded for countering dangers?
premises: Devouring and crushing are commanded twice.
items.inference: A prescribed sequence of repeated causative actions forms a ritual countermeasure against threats.
uncertainties: The specific targets or mantric applications of these commands are not stated in this unit.
items.plain_english: Twice cause to devour, cause to crush; twice cause to break; thrice cause to paralyze.
